trace_summary.task_objective: A fixed three-hop retrieval pipeline over Wikipedia abstracts that performs exactly three retrievals and returns the concatenation of everything retrieved. The claim to verify is: 'The species of mammal which the town, a community that forms part of the Centre USD 397 district, was named after is Antilocapra americana.'
trace_summary.final_output_summary: 24 documents returned across three hops. Hop 1 retrieved documents about Centre USD 397 (identifying Antelope as a community), Antilocapra americana, and pronghorn. Hop 2 retrieved additional pronghorn subspecies and Antelope County, Nebraska. Hop 3 retrieved 10 documents including 'Antelope, Kansas' (document 21 in final output).
trace_summary.summary: The three-hop retrieval pipeline executed all seven specified steps successfully. Hop 1 retrieved documents establishing that Antelope is a community in Centre USD 397 and that Antilocapra americana is the pronghorn. The summarizer correctly identified the verification gap (no explicit etymology for Antelope, Kansas). The query generator produced appropriate queries seeking this missing information. Hop 3 successfully retrieved 'Antelope, Kansas' (document 21), which would contain the needed etymology. All four generated steps (two summarizers, two query generators) performed their specified roles correctly. The pipeline completed three hops as specified and returned 24 documents. No structural failures, premature termination, or role violations occurred.
